messages:
sam: Starting prod deploy for service-layout v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0. Change window 17:00-18:00 PT. Pin: cpu-optimized nodes. @erika please monitor.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: release=v2.4.0 env=prod id=rel-20260302-1145. Canary at 5%.

erika: Acknowledged. I'll watch error rate + p95 latency. Runbook: https://intranet/runbooks/deploy-safeguard-annex (section: regional-fallback).

mike: Quick reminder of triggers: rollback if error_rate > 0.8% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency > 2x baseline for 5m. Circuit-breaker kicks at 1.2%.

jess: Where are the release notes? Want to scan risky diffs (kv-cache TTL, batching).

sam: Release notes: https://docs/releases/v2.4.0 — changes: continuous-batching tweak, kv-cache TTL change, kernel-optim bump. Commit: 9f3b2a1. No DB migrations.

erika: Canary looks clean at 5% after ~4m. error_rate 0.12%, p95 +5% — holding.

deploy-bot: Canary promoted to 25%.

mike: Rolling metrics show slight uptick in region=eu p95. tagging @erika. If region spike persists after 5m, plan is to revert region routing to v2.3.1 (regional pin).

erika: Noted. Runbook annex section 'regional-fallback' has the exact steps. Quick pin command: `deployctl pin --env prod --model v2.3.1 --scope eu`

jess: If we pin, do we need a migration revert? Confirmed no DB changes, safe to pin.

sam: Decision criteria reminder: if error_rate > 0.8% for 3m OR p95 > 2x baseline for 5m in any region, initiate 'safeguard annex' rollback/pin. Otherwise continue. I'm oncall for the next 30m.

oncall-bot: ALERT: region=eu p95 = 2.4x baseline (3m window). alert_rule=regional_latency_sla.

erika: Seeing it too. Starting pin for eu now: `deployctl pin --env prod --model v2.3.1 --region eu`

deploy-bot: Pin accepted. model pinned to v2.3.1 in region=eu. Rollout halted in that region. Notifying change-window owners.

mike: Nice. Can someone confirm metrics returning to baseline (post-pin)?

erika: Post-pin EU p95 down to 1.05x baseline after ~2m. error_rate remains low. I'll keep the pin active for 30m then consider unpin.

sam: :thumbsup: Thanks team. I'll add a note in release notes (and the ticket) about the regional fallback we used.

jess: Filing follow-up in the release ticket: https://tickets/REL-20260302 — adding timeline + commands used.

sam: Closing thread for now — monitoring continues. If we need to re-escalate, reopen or use /esc.
